nodes.rationale: Runs after Edit/Write/MultiEdit on UI files to surface design findings as system reminders — enforces design quality at edit time across all AI coding agents.

nodes.label: Lesson Completion Logic (30s next-lesson rule)
nodes.rationale: A lesson is marked complete when the video plays through OR when the user watches the NEXT module lesson for >30 seconds. Progress is saved every 5 seconds and restored on re-open.
